senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; תָּאֵו , v. אָוָה I) desire, appetite.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 120:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXX</cite> <he>עושה תַאֲוַת נפשו לשעה</he> he satisfies the lust of his soul for the moment; <he>עושה תַאֲוָתוֹ לשעה</he>.

<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:13">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 21:3">Ps. XXI, 3</cite>) <he>זכה תאות לבו וכ׳</he> if he is worthy, thou grantest him the desire of his heart (without prayer), if he is not worthy, thou refusest him not the prayer of his lips.
<cite ref="Sotah 47a:3">Sot. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>תאותו מיהא וכ׳</he> his desire at least was to curse.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 37:8">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXVII</cite> <he>לא עלתה בידו תאותו</he> he did not succeed in doing what he had desired to do.

<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 5:1">Tosef. Ber. V, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:1:2">Y. Pes. X, beg. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>בת׳</he> with an appetite for food, v. <cite ref="V00007"><he>תָּאֵב</he></cite>; [Bab.
ib. 99ᵇ כשהוא ת׳, v. תָּאַב]; Y. Succ. II, 53ᵃ bot.; a. fr.—בשר ת׳, v. בָּשָׂר.—Esp. sexual desire.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:1:13">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵃ</cite> <he>מכניס אהבה ומוציא ת׳</he> it (garlic) causes love to enter, and the sexual desire to come forth.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:5:1">Koh. R. to XII, 5</cite> (ref. to <he>אביונה</he>, <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:5:1">ib.</cite>) <he>זו הת׳</he> this means the sexual desire.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:1">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>מלאך … הת׳</he> the angel that is appointed over marital life.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:21">Ab. IV, 21</cite> <he>הקנאה והת׳ וכ׳</he> envy, voluptuousness, and ambition take man away from this world (accelerate his death); a. fr.
